description: Place an object from your personal inventory into the lot at (x,y,level) facing dir. Different from buy-object because no transaction runs; the object's persist-id is preserved. Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side VMTSOLotState.OwnerID gate). The referenced object must be present in your inventory. Effect: the object appears in nearby_objects; your inventory count decreases by 1. Cost: none (no money moves). Wire: VMNetPlaceInventoryCmd on the lot Aries socket.
